{"metadata":{"description":"Automated unit-test generation for DeepSeek Harness: /testgen command + generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix unit tests until they pass.","id":"gh:1334051613","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-testgen","slug":"bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen","topics":["ai","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","test-generation","testing","unit-test"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Automated unit-test generation for DeepSeek Harness: /testgen command + generate_tests tool that sca"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ffold, run, and fix unit tests until they pass."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-testgen"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Automated unit-test generation for DeepSeek Harness: a `/testgen` command and a `generate_tests` t"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ool that scaffold tests, run your project's test runner, and **fix failures until they pass** — boun"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ded, observable, and honest about what it changed."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness agents write code constantly — and leave it untested. `dsh-testgen` closes that loo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"p **inside the harness**:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **One command for humans** — `/testgen src/utils/math.ts` generates, runs, and fixes in a single s"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"tep.
- **One tool for agents** — the agent itself can call `generate_tests` after writing code, keep"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ing the loop in the session.
- **Two generators, no dead ends** — behavioral tests through your comp"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"osed LLM when available; deterministic structural smoke tests (zero LLM, works offline) otherwise.
-"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" **A real fix loop** — failures are parsed from vitest / jest / mocha / node:test output and fed bac"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"k to the LLM, up to a bounded number of iterations, only ever rewriting the test files it generated."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"No duplicated wheels: the ecosystem has git tools and eval harnesses, but no plugin that *generates,"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" runs, and fixes* unit tests as a first-class harness surface."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| ⚡ `/testgen` slash command | `[options] <file-or-glob>`, `--json`, `--help`; rendered directly in "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"the Web UI |
| 🛠️ `generate_tests` model tool | structured JSON input/output, cooperative cancellati"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"on, never runs in parallel |
| 🧠 LLM generator | streams through `ctx.llm`, honors your provider/mod"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"el, bounded source truncation |
| 🧩 Template generator | zero-dependency smoke tests scaffolded from"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" exported symbols — no API key needed |
| 🔁 Generate → run → fix loop | per-framework failure parsin"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"g, bounded by `maxIterations` |
| 🧪 Runner autodetect | vitest / jest / mocha detected from the proj"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ect; `node --test` as the universal fallback |
| 🔥 Hot-reloaded config | `testgen:` section in `sett"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ings.yaml`; edits apply on the next invocation, no restart |
| 🧰 Lifecycle-clean | registrations and"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" in-flight runs unwind with the plugin fiber; refuses to overwrite user tests |
| 📐 Typed end to end"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" | TypeScript, schemastery config, stable error codes, 78 unit tests including a real end-to-end run"},{"id":"p10s11","text":" TypeScript, schemastery config, stable error codes, 78 unit tests including a real end-to-end run |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Terminal-style demo (deterministic template generator + real `node --test` run):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In the Web UI, the plugin shows up in **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list** with an active status (re"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"al `dsh web` boot, 134 plugins loaded):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Requires Node ≥ 22 and `dsh` (DeepSeek Harness CLI)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and reconciles the bundle layer stack — the p"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"lugin declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest (`"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`), s"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"o no hand-editing is required. It works for any profile: `web`, `headless`, or your own. (An npm pac"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"kage will be published with the first stable dsh release it targets; pinning to a release tag is rec"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ommended once available.)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> Note for git/file installs: pnpm exits non-zero on missing peers for linked dependencies; that is "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"expected — the harness resolves the peer packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, cordis) from the profile's "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"own module fallback at boot. The plugin loads normally."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Verify it loaded (Web): **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list** shows the `testgen` entry with an activ"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ded (Web): **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list** shows the `testgen` entry with an active status dot."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Slash command"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Model tool"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The agent can call it directly — same pipeline, structured result:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### What gets written"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"For `src/utils/math.ts`, tests land in `src/utils/__tests__/math.test.ts` (framework-dependent; `nod"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e:test` uses `.test.mts`). Existing test files are **never overwritten** — a target that already has"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" a test file is skipped with a warning."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"All settings live under the `testgen:` key of your harness settings document (`$DSH_HOME/settings.ya"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ml`) and are **hot-reloaded** — edit, save, done.
